independent_review.scope: Independent decoded pixels plus sampled frames. Raw consecutive differences are diagnostics, not reconstruction accuracy or a temporal quality score.

manual_review.method: Codex visual inspection of both saved four-column contact sheets; sampled still frames only.
manual_review.target: SAM2 object 2: boy initially on the left; the other child is the retained foreground subject.

observations.finding: VACE fills include pale shapes and green/purple patches where the boy was removed; background bedding and wall continuity are not recovered.
VACE generates blue-gray blocks or rounded residual shapes near the retained child. These sampled frames include both sides of the first window overlap.
Colored blocks and figure-like residual shapes remain around the bed/legs; late-window samples have conspicuous artifacts. Samples include the second overlap and final short window.
Matched LaMa removes most of the target with fewer conspicuous colored hallucinations in these samples, while still leaving smeared bedding, soft patches and some overlap/limb remnants.

limits: Still samples cannot establish the presence or absence of continuous flicker.
Consecutive RGB differences are diagnostic, not ground-truth reconstruction or temporal quality scores.
Functional output and exact preservation outside the selected region do not establish generated-region quality.
